summary: Shows how to reference collection content by its fully qualified collection name (FQCN) in a playbook, including modules, roles via import_role, and lookup and filter plugins.
questions: How do I call a module from a collection in my playbook?
How do I use a role that lives inside a collection?
How do I reference a lookup or filter plugin from a collection?
What is an FQCN and how do I write one?

answer_card.title: Use collection content by FQCN
answer_card.answer_md:
After installing a collection, refer to its content by fully qualified collection name `namespace.collection.name`:

```yaml
- hosts: all
  tasks:
    - name: Call a module
      my_namespace.my_collection.my_module:
        option1: value

    - name: Import a role
      ansible.builtin.import_role:
        name: my_namespace.my_collection.role1

    - name: Use a lookup and filter
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: '{{ lookup("my_namespace.my_collection.lookup1", "param1") | my_namespace.my_collection.filter1 }}'
```

This works for roles and any plugin type in the collection.
